authorization.source: User in this chat explicitly requested continuous experiment-feedback-revision cycles after the alpha-mixture proposal.
authorization.scope: Local CPU fixed-feature D2 numerical studies; recurring schedule d2; first round alpha-mixture.

question: 固定输入与特征，连续改变线性/交互目标混合强度后，最佳点至两倍时间的泛化恶化，是否通常表现为噪声代价超过无噪声误差的改善？
hypothesis: At least 90% of eligible conditions have delta_B <= 1e-10*max(1,R0) and delta_noise > that tolerance. This is interval-net accounting, not pointwise monotonicity or a universal causal explanation.
target: (x0+alpha*x0*x1)/sqrt(1+alpha**2), population RMS normalized for independent standard Gaussian coordinates
model: Saved 128 fixed ReLU features plus constant; zero output initialization; full batch MSE GD eta=0.3, inherited exact response and active eigenvalue threshold.
search: Original integer 0..256 plus rounded 4096 geometric grid and inherited local integer refinement. Not exhaustive all integer extrema.
main_denominator: Only sigma2>0, 0<t_star<262144, 2*t_star<=262144, delta_R/R0>1e-6. Report all 324, all 270 positive-noise and per-exclusion counts plus eligible coverage; no eligible rows means inconclusive.
classification: No-noise, boundary, late-outside-window, flat/negligible, noise-overtakes-signal, signal-also-worsens, other are separate. delta_B>tol means B also increases, not that it dominates. Record signed delta_B/delta_noise/delta_R and expected noisy-train change; do not clip contribution ratios.
verification: Hash-check all 9 inputs against frozen d2 manifest. Gate dependency bytes against prereg commit. Reconstruct 90 alpha0/.5 positive-noise endpoint risks at original saved minima, tolerance1e-8 max(1,R0). 108 feature-space checks at sigma2=1 for t_star and2t_star. Noise response identical across alpha, finite, noise delta nonnegative and expected noisy train delta nonpositive within1e-10 max(1,R0). Negative within-window total delta beyond tolerance stops as search/numerics error.
domain: All development; alpha0 and.5 endpoints already observed. Intermediate strengths are new settings on old draws, not independent test data. Only3 master seeds; report per-alpha and per-seed no 270-independent-sample CI.
secondary: Report alpha-dependent stopping times, no-noise controls, and categories; no post-hoc fitting or claimed prediction improvement. B+sigma²N and identical N across target are analytic facts, not discoveries.
failure: Never overwrite output, preregistration or old evidence. Preserve failure, require amendment commit before changed execution. No automatic website publishing.
